name: Gun Probe (research)
description: Research for Exusiai's summoned guns: can a HUD addon show one of the game's own gun models hovering beside the view? F6 (0.1.8) spawns two Guard Dog bodies, hidden, each carrying a gun model linked to it, for 10 s (Alt+F6: dogs visible; Ctrl+F6: bare guns as in 0.1.7). Shift+F6 logs what the engine lets the addon reach. Bring an AX/AR-23 Guard Dog so its body and gun are loaded. Needs Bingus Shared Loader and HD2Runtime. Turn off when done.
